description: Machard de Gramont's 2014 Vosne-Romanée Premier Cru Les Gaudichots offers fragrant Pinot Noir in a cooler, more linear register. Red and black cherry, woodland spice, and fine tannin gather toward a long mineral finish.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 Domaine Machard de Gramont Vosne-Romanée Premier Cru Les Gaudichots.
palate: Silky fruit, fine tannin, mineral line
sommelierNotes: Serve at cellar temperature after a careful decant for sediment; pair with roast duck, veal, or game birds.
